paragraphs: (Ezekiel son of Buzi the Kohen.) Rav Chama bar Buzi: Berakhot 50a.[^1]

notes.text: The Biblical parenthesis and the Rav Chama bar Buzi pointer are kept distinct. The named William Davidson Berakhot 50a paragraph explicitly names Rav Chama bar Buzi. Hyman’s Biblical namesake parenthesis is retained without assigning that priestly title or genealogy to the amora’s father.
